edits.before: `home: false` omits VICTOR's default home projection so a domain projector can own the root route. Its artifact remains subject to the same collision checks as every other projection. `home: '<cell name>'` gives the root route to that published cell (a site's own home page), rendered as its page, in place of the catalog listing; the cell keeps its own route too, and a name that is not a published cell is a refusal.
edits.after: `home: false` omits VICTOR's default home projection so a domain projector can own the root route. Its artifact remains subject to the same collision checks as every other projection. `home: '<cell name>'` gives the root route to that published cell (a site's own home page), rendered as its page, in place of the catalog listing. The root is the cell's canonical URL; its ordinary `/<cell name>/` route becomes a noindex redirect to `/`, and references to the cell resolve to the root. The cell keeps its identity and publication membership. A missing or draft-excluded name is a refusal; a potential cell is available only in an explicitly enabled draft preview.
